description: Model upgrade banner: unsent drafts show the upgrade, and Switch saves the model without sending. The server offers an upgrade from the predictable model to a newer "Predictable Next" (ID predictable-next). The draft conversation {{ID}} (no slug yet) holds the unsent text "Not sent yet" on the predictable model; updating it (PUT /api/conversation/{{ID}}/draft) is faked, and call "switched draft" returns the JSON body of the first such PUT whose model is predictable-next, or "none". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{ID}}. 2. The text of the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-banner" should contain "Newer version of Predictable available". 3. Call "switched draft": it must return exactly "none". 4. Click the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-action". 5. Call "switched draft" until it returns exactly {"model":"predictable-next"} (that whole body and nothing else). 6. There must then be exactly 0 elements with data-testid "model-upgrade-banner". 7. The message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) must have the value exactly "Not sent yet".
